training.metric_caveat: The four force-only training frames have no energy labels but appear as zero-energy targets in MACE's unmasked train summary. An independent per-frame audit reproduces the 1697.4 meV/atom metric; it is a reporting artifact, not the labelled-frame error.

frozen_test.evidence: Aggregate change is small and one C-gap frame is worse; three structures do not establish broad transfer.

external_midpoint_checks.scope_note: These two midpoint geometries remain excluded from v13 training but are correlated with the Ag-C 2.30 A and Ag-Si 2.60 A training scans, which were generated by moving the central pair in these same source structures. Treat as related interpolation checks, not independent validation of registry or thermal configurations.

next_actions: Create independent Ag-C and Ag-Si interface perturbation geometries that are not central-pair distance-only scans; keep their PW-PBE labels outside v13 training.
Compare v13 predictions with those DFT labels. If errors exceed pre-agreed tolerances or remain physically inconsistent, add the structures to v14 training and retain separate unseen checks.
Keep candidate-structure long MD and TTM on hold until independent interface and static candidate checks pass.
